items.hed: The Houston Texans host the Indianapolis Colts tonight on a short week for Thursday Night Football, in a rivalry the Colts still lead 19-14-1 over the last 34 meetings
items.insight: Quarterback C.J. Stroud has thrown eight touchdowns over his last two games, and Houston enters the night ninth in the NFL in scoring offense at 25.9 points per game — 28.4 excluding its output against the Bengals — and fourth in passing offense, according to the team's own preview. The Texans will be without receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), edge rusher Danielle Hunter (hamstring), tight end Brevin Jordan (foot/illness) and running back Woody Marks (concussion), all ruled out on the official injury report, while linebacker Jacob Hummel, cornerback Jaylin Smith and guard Wyatt Teller are questionable. Indianapolis is down five players of its own — tackles Jalen Travis and Bernhard Raimann, defensive tackle Jerry Tillery, tight end Will Mallory and cornerback Charvarius Ward are all out — with cornerback Sauce Gardner and long snapper Luke Rhodes questionable. It's the fifth Thursday-night meeting between the two teams since 2011.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores made his first front-office hire official Thursday, bringing in former Cardinals executive Matt Bayer as an assistant general manager and naming Bobby Wilson the club's new bench coach
items.insight: Bayer, who spent time with the Cardinals organization in a senior baseball-operations role, becomes Flores's first significant addition to the Astros' front office since Flores was hired as general manager earlier this month, according to the team's own news page. Wilson was named bench coach the same day. The hires follow Houston's Nov. 12 announcement that Brad Ausmus, the longtime catcher and former Yankees bench coach, would return to the organization as its next manager.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets beat the Indiana Pacers on the road Wednesday night, with Amen Thompson playing through a knee injury to lead the team in rebounding, before hosting the Denver Nuggets Friday in NBA Cup group play
items.insight: Point guard Fred VanVleet dished six assists in the win, part of a November stretch in which he's averaging 14.0 points, 4.9 assists and 3.1 three-pointers per game, according to the team's own game notes. Forward Amen Thompson, who had missed Monday's loss to Miami with a knee injury, was cleared to play, led Houston in rebounds and scored nine of his 15 points in the first half; he's averaging 15.3 points, 7.6 rebounds and 3.0 assists per game this month. The Rockets don't play Thursday and host Denver Friday at Toyota Center at 10 p.m. ET.
